title: Lipase-Catalyzed Acetylation of Citronellol
author: Tu M. Ho
materials: One 50-ml Falcon tube ( Step 2 ) and four 15-ml Falcon tubes
Scale to weigh reagents (lipase powder in Step 2 , Falcon tube in Step 16 )
Lipase powder ( Candida rugosa Type VII, L1754-25G, Sigma) ( Step 2 ) Lipase powder from Candida rugosa
Glass capillaries to spot TLC solutions (or Pasteur pipets or optionally, 1 μL pipet tips with 1-10 μL micropipettor)
10-ml disposable syringe with cotton plug then sand then celite to filter reactions
apparatus to filter enzyme mixture (solid phase extraction) https://www.fishersci.com/shop/products/hypersep-glass-block-manifolds/p-4524468#?keyword=
tubing to connect house vacuum line to the solid phase extraction apparatus
nitrogen evaporator carousel to connect to the house air line with tubing
Dess Martin periodinane (10% w/v in dichloromethane, CAS #: 87413-09-0, MW: 424.
N α -(9-Fluorenylmethoxycarbonyl)- N γ -trityl-L-asparagine, N α -Fmoc- N γ -trityl-L-asparagine or Fmoc-Asn(Trt)-OH (CAS #: 132388-59-1 , MW: 596.

steps.title: Set up Lipase Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the lipase-catalyzed acetylation of citronellol in a 50-mL falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 200 mg of lipase powder into the tube.
Add 10 mL of hexanes.
Add 120 μL (0.103 g, 0.657 mmol, 1.0 equiv) of citronellol.
Add 250 μL (0.234 g, 2.71 mmol, 4.1 equiv) of vinyl acetate.

steps.title: Incubate Lipase Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction mixture in a water bath at 35–40 °C for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Monitor the reaction by TLC to ensure 50% conversion.

steps.title: Prepare TLC Chamber and Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the TLC materials while the lipase reaction is incubating.

substeps.instruction: Prepare standard starting material by adding 25 μL of citronellol to 1 mL of ethyl acetate.
Prepare 10 mL of TLC solvent (4:1 hexanes/ethyl acetate).

Prepare a TLC plate with 7 lanes: Lane 1 (racemic citronellol), Lane 2 (lipase reaction filtrate), Lane 3 (RXN B esterified product), Lane 4 (DMP reaction), Lane 5 (RXN A2 organic layer), Lane 6 (RXN A2 aqueous layer), Lane 7 (hydrolyzed citronellyl acetate).

steps.title: Filter Lipase Residue
steps.instruction: Filter the reaction mixture to remove the lipase powder using a vacuum setup.

substeps.instruction: Pack a disposable syringe with a cotton pad, sand, and celite.
Place the syringe on a solid phase extraction apparatus connected to a vacuum line, with a 15-mL Falcon tube as the collection vessel.
Filter the reaction mixture through the celite.
Spot the resulting clear solution on Lane 2 of the TLC plate.

steps.title: Split Filtrate into RXN A and B
steps.instruction: Divide the approximately 9 mL of filtrate into two separate 15-mL falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Allocate about 6 mL to tube RXN A.
Allocate about 3 mL to tube RXN B.

steps.title: Concentrate RXN B
steps.instruction: Evaporate the hexanes solvent from RXN B using air flow in a carousel for approximately 15 minutes.

steps.title: Oxidize RXN A with DMP
steps.instruction: Perform DMP oxidation of citronellol to citronellal in RXN A.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly shake the stock solution of Dess-Martin Periodinane (10% w/v in DCM) to resuspend white precipitate.
Add 1.7 mL of the DMP solution to RXN A.
Wait 30 minutes at room temperature, shaking and mixing the reaction every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Filter and Concentrate DMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Filter the DMP reaction (RXN A1) and remove solvent.

substeps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a syringe column (cotton, sand, celite).
Rinse the residue in the tube with approximately 2 mL of DCM.
Label the collected filtrate as 'RXN A1' and spot it on Lane 4 of the TLC plate.
Evaporate the filtrate under air until mostly no liquid remains.

steps.title: Esterify RXN B with Asparagine Derivative
steps.instruction: Perform derivatization of unreacted citronellol in RXN B.

substeps.instruction: To RXN B, add 4 mL of DCM, 8 mg (0.033 mmol) of DMAP, 66 mg (0.32 mmol) of DCC, and 190 mg (0.32 mmol) of Fmoc-Asn(Trt)-OH.
Run the reaction at room temperature, shaking and mixing occasionally (solution should turn yellow).

steps.title: Prepare Pinnick Oxidation Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary reagents for the Pinnick reaction (RXN A2).

substeps.instruction: Prepare NaClO2 solution: dissolve 200 mg NaClO2 (2.2 mmol) in 400 μL H2O.
Prepare Solution X: mix 2 mL t-BuOH, 500 μL H2O, 450 μL 2-methyl-2-butene, and 192 mg NaH2PO4.

steps.title: Perform Pinnick Oxidation (RXN A2)
steps.instruction: Oxidize the aldehyde/acetate mixture from RXN A1 to citronellic acid.

substeps.instruction: To the concentrated RXN A1 tube, add 200 μL of the NaClO2 solution and 2 mL of Solution X.
Run the reaction at room temperature for 30 minutes, shaking and mixing occasionally by hand.

steps.title: Work up RXN B for NMR
steps.instruction: Extract and prepare the esterified product from RXN B for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of water to RXN B, then shake and vent three times.
Use a pipet to draw out the bottom organic layer and transfer to a 15-mL falcon tube labeled 'Organic B'.
Spot the solution on Lane 3 of the TLC plate.
Evaporate 'Organic B' under air flow until no solvent remains.
Add 500 μL of CDCl3 to the crude residue for NMR analysis.

steps.title: Separate Citronellic Acid from RXN A2
steps.instruction: Extract the carboxylic acid from the Pinnick reaction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of 30% (w/v) NaOH solution (pH 11) and 2 mL of hexanes to RXN A2.
Shake and vent, then separate the bottom aqueous layer using a pipet.
Repeat the extraction two more times (2 x 2 mL 30% NaOH).
Combine the three aqueous layers in a 15-mL falcon tube labeled 'aqueous A2' and spot on Lane 6 of the TLC plate.
Spot the remaining top organic layer (hexanes) on Lane 5 of the TLC plate.

steps.title: Hydrolyze Citronellyl Acetate (RXN A3)
steps.instruction: Hydrolyze the acetate in the organic layer from RXN A2.

substeps.instruction: To the organic layer, add 2 mL of 30% (w/v) NaOH solution and 2 mL of MeOH.
Shake vigorously for at least 5 minutes.
Allow the reaction to complete (approximately 30 minutes), shaking constantly.

steps.title: Recover Citronellol and Measure Rotation
steps.instruction: Recover the citronellol from the hydrolysis reaction for optical rotation analysis.

substeps.instruction: Separate the top organic layer using a pipet.
Extract the aqueous layer again by adding 2 mL of hexanes and collecting the top layer.
Spot the combined organic layer on Lane 7 of the TLC plate.
Evaporate the organic solvent in a tared 15-mL Falcon tube to determine the weight of recovered citronellol.
Prepare for optical rotation by adding 10 mL of DCM to 5-10 μL of the recovered citronellol.

steps.title: Perform Final TLC Analysis
steps.instruction: Develop and visualize the TLC plate to analyze all reaction stages.

substeps.instruction: Place the spotted TLC plate in the chamber, ensuring the solvent level is below the origin spots.
Once developed, dry the solvent and stain the plate with CAM stain solution.
Dry excess stain with a paper towel and apply gentle heat (hot plate or heat gun) until spots appear.
Calculate Rf values for all 7 lanes.
